reviews.guide_answer:
Reviews are comments from your customers. They show on a page of their own when you turn them on. Each review shows the person's name, a star rating, the date, and what they wrote.

Open Settings, then Features, and set Reviews to Enabled. A Reviews link then appears in the public site menu.

Open Site → Reviews to add, change, or delete a review. The page starts with one sample review.
